entry.title: Trip report: CppCon 2026

entry.title: C++26: Trivial infinite loops are no longer undefined behaviour

link.title: C++26: Trivial infinite loops are no longer undefined behaviour

entry.summary: Let’s start with a question! Is this program well-defined? int main() { while (true) ; } If you said yes, you’d be wrong — at least before C++26. A while (true); loop with no side effects used to be undefined behaviour. entry.summary: C++20 introduced modules as a - potential - fundamental shift in how we organize and consume C++ code.
